description: Toybox 10K wave 2 wild animals: hare and arctic_hare, snake, tortoise and turtle_hatchling (from turtle), coyote and wolf (from fox), arctic_fox and arctic_fox_summer, toad and spadefoot_toad (from frog), newt, axolotl and axolotl_wild, badger, chipmunk, dormouse (from mouse), pocket_gopher, sloth, snow_leopard, elk, mouse_deer, tardigrade and tardigrade_tun, termite, termite_soldier and termite_queen. Generated by tools/gen_tk_wild2.mjs: edit the generator and rerun it, not the JSON.

hare.description: A long-eared, long-legged brown hare, taller and leaner than the bunny, with a sandy belly and muzzle, black-tipped ears and big hind feet; sits up on its haunches. About 1.6 m to the ear tips at size 1. Named parts: ears (both, twitch on their own), paw (both front legs, for point and wave), leg_back (both hind legs with their long feet, pivot at the hip: turn [-30, 0, 0] about x to kick off a hop), tail (white puff).

arctic_hare.description: The hare in its white Arctic (or snowshoe winter) coat: snow-white fur with a cream belly and muzzle, black ear tips and long hind legs; sits up tall (a judge with a clipboard: parent the prop to it). Same named parts as hare: ears, paw, leg_back, tail. About 1.6 m to the ear tips at size 1.

snake.description: A gentle round-faced green snake coiled in two loops, with a cream belly stripe up its neck, darker green spots, big friendly eyes, a wide soft smile and no fangs. Its neck rises from the coil, so the head sways and nods (look, nod, feelings). About 1.05 m tall at size 1, 1 m across the coil. Named part: tail (the tip poking out of the bottom coil, wiggles on its own).

tortoise.description: A slow, gentle land tortoise: a high domed dark-brown shell patterned with golden hexagon plates over a golden rim, sandy skin, sturdy column legs with little cream toenails and a calm smile; plods and nods. About 0.95 m tall at size 1 (to the top of the shell), 1.1 m long. Named parts: shell, leg_front and leg_back (each a mirrored pair: turn [±15, 0, 0] about x in turn to plod), tail.

turtle_hatchling.description: A tiny baby sea turtle just out of its egg: a soft dark-gray shell with a blue-gray rim, gray skin, big eyes for its size and long paddle flippers that scramble over sand. About 0.33 m tall and 0.5 m long at size 1 (the turtle is 0.8 m). Named parts: flipper (both front flippers, for point and the scramble: turn [0, ±30, 0] in turn), shell, tail.

coyote.description: A lean sandy-tan young coyote: the fox's build in sandy fur with a cream snout, chest and tail tip, tall ears, dark paws and a bushy tail; trots and tilts its head when curious, hopeful and friendly. About 1.1 m tall at size 1. Named part: tail (swishes on its own).

wolf.description: A friendly storybook gray wolf: bigger than the fox, thick gray coat with a cream snout, chest and tail tip, warm amber eyes, tall ears and a bushy tail; trots, sniffs and tips its head up to howl softly, never scary. About 1.25 m tall at size 1. Named part: tail (swishes on its own).

arctic_fox.description: A small arctic fox in its thick white winter coat: a round head with a short cream muzzle, small rounded ears, short legs and a huge bushy tail curled beside it. About 0.95 m tall at size 1 (smaller and rounder than the fox). Named parts: ears, paw (both front legs, for point), tail (big and fluffy, swishes). For the brown-gray summer coat use arctic_fox_summer, or paint between them.

arctic_fox_summer.description: The arctic fox in its brown summer coat: brown fur with a sandy muzzle, chest and tail tip, small rounded ears, short legs and a huge bushy tail. About 0.95 m tall at size 1. Same named parts as arctic_fox: ears, paw, tail.

toad.description: A round, bumpy-but-cute brown toad in storybook style: dark brown warts on its back and head, a sandy throat and belly, big golden eyes on top and a wide smile; waves, walks and makes small hops (out of a book page too). About 0.8 m tall at size 1 (to the eye tops). Named parts: arm (both front legs, for wave and point), leg_back (both hind legs with their feet, pivot at the hip: turn [-35, 0, 0] about x to hop).

spadefoot_toad.description: A small round sandy-brown desert toad with brown warts, golden eyes, a wide smile and a dark hard spade ridge on each back foot for digging backward into soil; can pop up out of the sand. About 0.58 m tall at size 1. Named parts: arm (front legs), leg_back (hind legs with the spades, pivot at the hip).

newt.description: A small smooth newt: a long low olive-brown body and long flat tail with a little crest, a speckled orange belly that shows along its sides, four tiny legs, golden eyes and a gentle smile; swims and pauses on pondweed. About 0.33 m tall and 1.1 m long at size 1. Named parts: tail (wags on its own), leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right.

axolotl.description: A small smiling axolotl, the pale-pink kind: a soft pink body and wide flat head, three feathery rose gills on each side of its head, little dark eyes, a very wide smile, tiny legs and a long tail with a pale fin. About 0.4 m tall and 1.1 m long at size 1. Named parts: gills (all six, flutter on their own), tail, leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right. The dark speckled wild kind is axolotl_wild.

axolotl_wild.description: The wild axolotl: dark speckled brown with a sandy belly and fin, dusky rose-violet feathery gills, little eyes and a wide smile. About 0.4 m tall at size 1. Same named parts as axolotl: gills, tail, the four legs.

badger.description: A stocky gray European badger: a low wide gray body, dark short legs, a white face with a black stripe over each eye from nose to ear, a white-tipped snout, small ears and blunt cream front claws for digging; sniffs the ground and shuffles backward. About 0.8 m tall and 1.1 m long at size 1. Named parts: leg_front_left, leg_front_right (with their claws), leg_back_left, leg_back_right, ears, tail.

chipmunk.description: A small striped chipmunk: chestnut fur with dark and cream stripes down its back and through its eyes, round full cheeks, a cream belly, little round ears and a bushy tail; pops out of a burrow and waves. About 0.85 m tall at size 1 (a little smaller than the squirrel, no acorn). Named parts: paw (both front paws, for wave and point), ears, tail (swishes on its own), legs (both feet).

dormouse.description: A tiny golden-brown hazel dormouse with a cream tummy and muzzle, big black eyes, round ears and a thick fluffy golden tail curled up behind; curls into a ball to sleep in a nest of leaves. About 0.68 m tall at size 1 (smaller than the mouse). Named part: tail (swishes on its own).

pocket_gopher.description: A small sandy-brown pocket gopher: a chubby body, big puffy fur-lined cheek pouches, tiny eyes, a pink nose, two little front teeth, tiny ears, a short tail and strong front paws with big blunt cream digging claws; pops up from a soil mound. About 0.85 m tall at size 1. Named parts: paw (both front paws with their claws, for point and digging), pouches (both cheek pouches), tail.

sloth.description: A gentle three-toed-style sloth with shaggy brown fur, a pale cream face with dark eye patches, a dark nose and a sleepy smile, and long curved cream claws; its arms reach up over its head to hang from a branch and it moves very slowly. About 1.4 m tall at size 1 to the raised hands (a branch held at about y 1.38 sits in its claws). Named parts: arm (both arms, pivot at the shoulder: turn [0, 0, ±150] to lower them, or slowly in turn to climb), legs (both legs dangling).

snow_leopard.description: A pale smoky-gray snow leopard standing on four legs: dark ring rosettes on its back and sides, a white muzzle and chest, small rounded ears, wide furry paws, soft green eyes and a very long thick ringed tail; moves silently. About 1.2 m tall and 1.9 m long with the tail at size 1. Named parts: leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right (each with its paw, pivot at the hip: turn [±20, 0, 0] to walk), tail (sways), ears.

elk.description: A large calm brown elk (wapiti) bull: a dark chocolate neck, a pale sandy rump and tiny tail, a long dark muzzle, leaf-shaped ears, long legs on dark hooves and wide cream antlers with tines; grazes and walks calmly. About 1.95 m tall to the antler tips at size 1 (head top about 1.55). Named parts: antlers (drop them for a cow elk), ears, tail, leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right (each with its hoof, pivot at the hip: turn [±20, 0, 0] to walk).

mouse_deer.description: Sang Kancil the mouse deer: a tiny slender chestnut deer with a cream belly, white throat stripes, a pointed dark nose, big dark shiny eyes, small round ears, thin legs on little dark hooves and a stubby tail; quick and twinkly. About 0.78 m tall at size 1 (head top). Named parts: ears, tail, leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right (each with its hoof, pivot at the hip).

tardigrade.description: A tiny chubby water bear (tardigrade), as seen under a microscope and made cute: a plump soft cream body in round segments, a round head with a little round snout ring, small eyes and a smile, and eight stubby legs with tiny dark claws that paddle slowly. About 0.55 m tall and 0.95 m long at size 1 (a toy blown up from microscope size). Named parts: leg_1 .. leg_4 (each a mirrored pair, front to back, paddling on their own). Its dry curled barrel (tun) is tardigrade_tun.

tardigrade_tun.description: The water bear dried out and curled into its barrel-shaped tun: legs pulled in, a golden dry shell of segments, eyes and a small calm face; swap tardigrade for this (or back) to show it curling up and reviving. About 0.5 m tall at size 1.

termite.description: A small pale cartoon worker termite: a round golden-brown head with eyes and a smile, beaded antennae, a cream ringed body and six thin legs; moves in busy lines. About 0.5 m tall and 0.6 m long at size 1. Named parts: legs (all six), antennae. The big-jawed soldier is termite_soldier and the large queen termite_queen.

termite_soldier.description: A soldier termite: the worker's pale ringed body with a much bigger golden-brown head and two big rounded dark-brown jaws held out in front (friendly, never biting). About 0.55 m tall at size 1. Named parts: jaws (both, pivot at the head: turn [0, ±10, 0] to open and close), legs, antennae.

termite_queen.description: The termite queen: a bigger termite with a huge long cream abdomen striped with golden bands stretching out behind her, and a small gold crown. About 0.75 m tall and 1.9 m long at size 1. Named parts: abdomen, crown, legs, antennae.
